about.contact.account.description: Term before the account of this server to contact about the server, on the server's information page.

about.contact.email.description: Term before the email address to contact about the server, on the server's information page.

about.contact.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page with how to reach the server's operators.

about.status.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that links to the server's status page, on another site.

about.status.description.defaultMessage: The operators tell of outages and maintenance of this server on its status page, which stays reachable when this server does not answer.
about.status.description.description: Paragraph in the server status section of the server's information page: what the status page is for.

about.status.link.description: Link to the server's status page, on another site, on the server's information page. The link leaves the app.

about.description.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page with the server's description.

about.domains.empty.description: Shown in place of the list of moderated servers when there are none.

about.domains.failed.description: Heading shown in place of the list of moderated servers when it could not be loaded.

about.domains.intro.defaultMessage: This server limits or suspends federation with these servers.
about.domains.intro.description: Explanation under the heading of the list of moderated servers on the server's information page.

about.domains.kind.limit.defaultMessage: Limited: its posts stay off the public timelines
about.domains.kind.limit.description: Next to a server in the list of moderated servers: its posts stay off the public timelines and its accounts reach only their followers.

about.domains.kind.suspend.description: Next to a server in the list of moderated servers: this server does not federate with it at all.

about.domains.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while the list of moderated servers loads.

about.domains.more.description: Button under the list of moderated servers that loads more of them.

about.domains.more_failed.description: Shown under the list of moderated servers when its next page could not be loaded.

about.domains.obfuscated.defaultMessage: Some server names are partly hidden with *.
about.domains.obfuscated.description: Note above the list of moderated servers when the moderators hid part of some servers' names.

about.domains.retry.description: Button that tries again to load the list of moderated servers after a failure.

about.domains.sign_in.description: Link after the note that only signed-in users can see the list of moderated servers; it opens the sign-in screen.

about.domains.signed_in_only.defaultMessage: Only signed-in users can see this list.
about.domains.signed_in_only.description: Shown in place of the list of moderated servers to a visitor who is not signed in, when the server shows it to signed-in users only.

about.domains.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that lists the other servers whose federation this server limits or suspends.

about.crawlers.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that says what the server states to search engines and AI crawlers.

about.crawlers.search.defaultMessage: {setting, select, allow {Search engines may index the profiles and public posts of the accounts that allow it.} other {This server asks search engines not to index any of its pages.}}
about.crawlers.search.description: What the server states to search engines, by the server setting search_indexing (allow or deny).

about.crawlers.ai.defaultMessage: {setting, select, allow {This server reserves nothing against AI: AI may train on and use its pages, except those of the accounts that opt out.} deny_training {This server reserves its pages against the training of AI models. AI search and assistants may still use them, except the pages of the accounts that opt out.} other {This server reserves its pages against the training of AI models and against their use by AI search, assistants and agents.}}
about.crawlers.ai.description: What the server states to AI crawlers, by the server setting ai_usage (allow, deny_training, or deny).

about.crawlers.details.defaultMessage: How the server states it, and what it means in law
about.crawlers.details.description: Summary of the folded details under the server's statements to search engines and AI: how it states them, the accounts' own choices, and their legal meaning.

about.crawlers.how.defaultMessage: The server states this in its robots.txt (with a list of known AI crawlers), in the robots meta tag and the X-Robots-Tag, Content-Usage and tdm-reservation headers of its pages, and in /.well-known/tdmrep.json. These are requests: well-known crawlers say they follow some of them, but nothing technically stops a crawler that does not.
about.crawlers.how.description: How the server states its search and AI settings: the machine-readable means it uses.

about.crawlers.accounts.defaultMessage: Each account can also keep its profile and posts out of search engines, or deny AI, for its own pages on this server. An account cannot allow what the server denies. Media files and copies of posts on other servers do not carry an account's choice.
about.crawlers.accounts.description: That each account can narrow the server's statement for its own pages, but never widen it.

about.crawlers.legal.defaultMessage: What such a statement means in law depends on the country, and many operators follow such statements voluntarily. This text is not legal advice.
about.crawlers.legal.description: The legal note under the server's AI statement. Must not promise a legal effect.

about.link_card_crawler.title.description: Heading (h1) of the page that tells the operators of other websites about the crawler that fetches the links in posts. {instance} is the server's name.

about.link_card_crawler.intro.defaultMessage: When a post on this server links to a web page, the server fetches that page to show a card with its title, description, and image. This page is for the people who run those websites: what the requests are, and how to refuse them.
about.link_card_crawler.intro.description: Opening paragraph of the page about the link card crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.state.obeys.defaultMessage: On this server, the crawler is on and it obeys robots.txt.
about.link_card_crawler.state.obeys.description: What the crawler does on this server, in its usual settings: at the top of the page about the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.state.ignores.defaultMessage: On this server, the crawler is on and it does not read robots.txt, because the operators chose so. A website cannot refuse it here with robots.txt. The directives of a page still apply, and the operators can stop fetching from a domain.
about.link_card_crawler.state.ignores.description: What the crawler does on a server whose setting link_cards_ignore_robots_txt is on: at the top of the page about the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.state.off.defaultMessage: On this server, link cards are off, so the crawler fetches nothing now. The rest of this page says what it does while they are on.
about.link_card_crawler.state.off.description: What the crawler does on a server whose setting link_cards is off: at the top of the page about the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.loading.description: Label of the spinner while the page about the crawler loads the settings of the server.

about.link_card_crawler.failed.defaultMessage: Could not load what the crawler does on this server
about.link_card_crawler.failed.description: Heading of the error in place of the page about the crawler when the settings of the server cannot be read.

about.link_card_crawler.retry.description: Button that loads the settings of the server again after a failure, on the page about the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.identity.title.description: Heading of the section with the User-Agent of the link card crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.identity.user_ag.description: Sentence before the User-Agent of the crawler, shown as code.

about.link_card_crawler.identity.token.defaultMessage: The address in it is this server. In robots.txt and in the directives of a page, the crawler is named my-linkcard.
about.link_card_crawler.identity.token.description: Explains the User-Agent of the crawler and the name it goes by. my-linkcard is a literal name: do not translate it.

about.link_card_crawler.identity.others.defaultMessage: This server makes other requests under the name my/, which this page does not cover, such as federation. Two of them can follow a card: it may fetch the card's image again as my/ to show it to readers, and it looks up the fediverse:creator account a page names.
about.link_card_crawler.identity.others.description: Other requests of the server that a site operator can see, under the server's general User-Agent. my/ and fediverse:creator are literal: do not translate them.

about.link_card_crawler.trigger.title.description: Heading of the section that says what makes the crawler fetch a URL.

about.link_card_crawler.trigger.post.defaultMessage: A post that links the URL. The server makes a card from the first link in the body of a post, whatever the post's visibility, and fetches the page if it has no recent card of it.
about.link_card_crawler.trigger.post.description: What makes the crawler fetch a URL.

about.link_card_crawler.trigger.remote.defaultMessage: That includes posts that arrive from other servers, not only those written here, so a request does not mean that someone here read your page.
about.link_card_crawler.trigger.remote.description: That posts federated from other servers cause fetches too.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.title.description: Heading of the section that lists what the crawler requests from a website.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.page.defaultMessage: The page. It reads only the head of the page, follows up to 5 redirects, and runs nothing in it.
about.link_card_crawler.fetches.page.description: What the crawler fetches: the linked page.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.image.defaultMessage: One image, the one that the head of the page names.
about.link_card_crawler.fetches.image.description: What the crawler fetches: the page's image.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.robots.defaultMessage: robots.txt of the origin of the page and of the image, before it requests them.
about.link_card_crawler.fetches.robots.description: What the crawler fetches: robots.txt. Shown only while the server reads it.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.nothing_.defaultMessage: It follows no links, so it does not crawl the rest of your site.
about.link_card_crawler.fetches.nothing_.description: That the crawler does not crawl a whole website.

about.link_card_crawler.sends.title.description: Heading of the section that says what the crawler's requests carry.

about.link_card_crawler.sends.headers.defaultMessage: The User-Agent above, the kinds of content it accepts, and for a page, this server's default language in Accept-Language.

about.link_card_crawler.sends.not.defaultMessage: It sends no cookies and no Referer, and nothing tells you which account or post linked the page.
about.link_card_crawler.sends.not.description: What the crawler's requests do not carry.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.title.description: Heading of the section that says how often the crawler requests a URL.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.once.defaultMessage: Each URL is fetched once, and the posts that link it share its card. A post fetches it again only if the last fetch was 14 days ago or more; the server does not go back over its cards by itself.
about.link_card_crawler.frequency.once.description: How often the crawler requests a page.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.failur.defaultMessage: A URL that fails is not requested again for 24 hours.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.host.defaultMessage: It makes one request at a time to a host, with at least a second between them. Only the redirects of a request and the robots.txt it needs come with it.
about.link_card_crawler.frequency.host.description: The limit of the crawler per host.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.thrott.defaultMessage: When a host answers 429 or 503, the crawler requests nothing from it for the time in Retry-After, at most an hour, or for a minute without one. After 5 such answers for a URL, it counts the URL as failed.
about.link_card_crawler.frequency.thrott.description: That the crawler stops for a host that asks it to. 429, 503 and Retry-After are literal.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.robots.defaultMessage: robots.txt is read about once a day per origin (scheme, host, and port). When it cannot be read (429, 5xx, or a network failure), the crawler fetches nothing from the origin and tries again an hour later.
about.link_card_crawler.frequency.robots.description: How often the crawler reads robots.txt. Shown only while the server reads it.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.title.description: Heading of the section that says how a website refuses the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.t.description: Heading (h3) of the part about refusing the crawler in robots.txt. robots.txt is literal.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.i.defaultMessage: To refuse every fetch from your site, add this to robots.txt:
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.i.description: Sentence before the robots.txt example that refuses the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.s.defaultMessage: Without a group of that name, the crawler follows the group for *. Allow, Disallow, *, and $ are read, as RFC 9309 says, so you can also refuse only some paths.
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.s.description: How the crawler reads robots.txt. Allow, Disallow, *, $ and RFC 9309 are literal.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.t.defaultMessage: The crawler obeys a new rule within a day. A card it already has goes when a post fetches its URL again, or sooner if you ask the operators.
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.t.description: When a change of robots.txt takes effect.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.i.defaultMessage: This server does not read robots.txt, so this rule has no effect here. It applies on servers that obey it.
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.i.description: Under the robots.txt part, on a server whose setting link_cards_ignore_robots_txt is on.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: Limit the card: directives of a page
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: Heading (h3) of the part about the page directives that change a card.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: A page can keep its description or its image out of the card. The crawler still requests the page, since it learns the directives from it. These work whatever the setting of robots.txt on this server:
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: Sentence before the table of page directives.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: What each directive changes in a card
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: Visually hidden name of the table of page directives.
Column header: what the directive does to the card.
What the directives nosnippet and max-snippet:0 do to a card.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: No image, and the image is not requested.
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: What the directives noimageindex and max-image-preview:none do to a card.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: No change. These ask to stay out of search results, and a card is not a search result: it appears only because someone posted the link, and many pages that stay out of search are meant to be shared. To refuse, use robots.txt.
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: What the directives noindex and none do to a card, with the reason in plain words.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: No change. These ask to stay out of search results, and a card is not a search result: it appears only because someone posted the link, and many pages that stay out of search are meant to be shared. To refuse on this server, ask its operators.
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: What the directives noindex and none do to a card, on a server that does not read robots.txt.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: The title, the site name, and the author stay under every directive.
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: What no page directive removes from a card.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: Write them in a meta tag named robots or my-linkcard in the head of the page, or in an X-Robots-Tag header:
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: Sentence before the examples of where a directive goes. robots, my-linkcard and X-Robots-Tag are literal.

about.link_card_crawler.contact.title.description: Heading of the section with how to reach the operators of the server that runs the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.contact.intro.defaultMessage: The operators can stop the crawler on a domain and its subdomains, or stop only its images. That takes effect at once, also on the cards the server already has, so ask them if you need a fetch to stop or a card to go.
about.link_card_crawler.contact.intro.description: That the operators of the server can stop the crawler per domain, and that a site operator can ask them.

about.link_card_crawler.contact.none.description: In place of the contact details when the server has none.

about.link_card_crawler.contact.about.description: Link from the page about the crawler to the server's information page.

about.crawlers.link_cards.defaultMessage: The server also fetches the pages that posts link to, to show cards of them, as the crawler my-linkcard.
about.crawlers.link_cards.description: In the section of the server's information page about crawlers: that the server itself runs a crawler too, for link cards. my-linkcard is a literal name.

about.crawlers.link_cards_link.defaultMessage: What that crawler does, and how a website refuses it
about.crawlers.link_cards_link.description: Link to the page about the server's own crawler (/about/crawler) from the server's information page.

about.costs.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page about what running the server costs, shown when the server publishes its costs.

about.costs.description.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, breakdown {This server publishes what it costs to run by week, month, and year, with a breakdown by provider and category. The names of the items, their notes, and the individual payments are not published.} other {This server publishes the totals of what it costs to run by week, month, and year. What they are spent on, the names of the items, and the individual payments are not published.}}
about.costs.description.description: What the server publishes of its running costs, by the server setting finance_visibility (totals or breakdown).

about.income.description.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, plans {This server publishes its income from its supporters by week, month, and year, after the payment provider's fees and refunds, and how many members each plan has now. Who paid and how much each paid are not published.} other {This server publishes the totals of its income from its supporters by week, month, and year, after the payment provider's fees and refunds. Who paid and how much each paid are not published.}}
about.income.description.description: What the server publishes of its income from the supporter plans, by the server setting income_visibility (totals or plans).

about.income.balance.defaultMessage: It also publishes the balance: the income less the costs.
about.income.balance.description: Note on the server's information page that the balance (income less costs) is published, shown when both the costs and the income are published.

about.costs.link.defaultMessage: {shown, select, both {See the running costs and income} income {See the income} other {See the running costs}}
about.costs.link.description: Link from the server's information page to the page of the server's running costs and income, by what the server publishes: both, the income only, or the costs only.

about.commerce.title.description: Heading of the section of the information page that links to the server's page of the commerce disclosures of its supporter plans (ADR-0072 §13).

about.commerce.link.description: Link from the information page to the server's page of the commerce disclosures of its supporter plans.

about.external_review.inbound_follow.defaultMessage: Follows from other servers: who follows whom.
about.external_review.inbound_follow.description: What the external review of follows covers and what is sent to it.

about.external_review.inbound_status.defaultMessage: {unfollowedDirect, select, true {Posts from other servers that this server takes in, posts for followers and for mentioned people included: their text, who sent them, and whether someone here follows the sender.} other {Posts from other servers that this server takes in, posts for followers included: their text, who sent them, and whether someone here follows the sender. Posts for mentioned people are sent only when someone here follows the sender.}}
about.external_review.inbound_status.description: What the external review of posts from other servers covers and what is sent to it. {unfollowedDirect} is true when posts for mentioned people are sent also from senders no one on this server follows.

about.external_review.intro.defaultMessage: This server asks an external service to review the following before it accepts them. The review can only stop or mark what it reviews, and people decide on any action against an account.
about.external_review.intro.description: Introduction of the section of the information page about the external review.

about.external_review.local_status.defaultMessage: {days, plural, =0 {Posts by every account of this server, and their edits: their text and the author's username. Posts for followers and for mentioned people are not sent.} one {Posts by accounts of this server created in the last day, and their edits: their text and the author's username. Posts for followers and for mentioned people are not sent.} other {Posts by accounts of this server created in the last # days, and their edits: their text and the author's username. Posts for followers and for mentioned people are not sent.}}
about.external_review.local_status.description: What the external review of local posts and their edits covers and what is sent to it. {days} is how many days after its creation an account's posts and edits are sent; 0 means the posts of every account are.

about.external_review.inbound_actor.defaultMessage: Profiles of accounts on other servers, when they change: the display name, the bio, the profile fields, and the addresses of the avatar and the header image.
about.external_review.inbound_actor.description: What the external review of the profiles of accounts on other servers covers and what is sent to it.

about.external_review.local_profile.defaultMessage: {days, plural, =0 {Changes to the profile of every account of this server: the display name, the bio, the profile fields, and whether the avatar or header changed. The images are not sent.} one {Changes to the profiles of accounts of this server created in the last day: the display name, the bio, the profile fields, and whether the avatar or header changed. The images are not sent.} other {Changes to the profiles of accounts of this server created in the last # days: the display name, the bio, the profile fields, and whether the avatar or header changed. The images are not sent.}}
about.external_review.local_profile.description: What the external review of local profiles covers and what is sent to it. {days} is how many days after its creation an account's profile changes are sent; 0 means those of every account are.

about.external_review.media_check.defaultMessage: Uploaded media: a small processed version, never the original.
about.external_review.media_check.description: What the external review of uploaded media covers and what is sent to it.

about.external_review.signup_check.defaultMessage: Sign-ups: the email address and the IP address.
about.external_review.signup_check.description: What the external review of sign-ups covers and what is sent to it.

about.external_review.title.description: Heading of the section of the information page that says the server uses an external review of submissions.

about.licenses.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that links to the license notices of the third-party software, data and fonts that the web app bundles.

about.licenses.intro.defaultMessage: The web app bundles software, data and fonts made by others, each under its own license; their license notices follow.
about.licenses.intro.description: Paragraph before the list of links to the license notices of the third-party software, data and fonts that the web app bundles, on the server's information page.

about.licenses.npm.description: Link to the plain-text license notices of the npm packages bundled into the web app's code, on the server's information page.

about.licenses.npm_sw.defaultMessage: npm packages in the offline support (Service Worker)
about.licenses.npm_sw.description: Link to the plain-text license notices of the npm packages bundled into the web app's Service Worker, which keeps the app working offline, on the server's information page.

about.licenses.unicode.defaultMessage: Unicode emoji data and CLDR emoji names (Unicode License v3)
about.licenses.unicode.description: Link to the plain-text Unicode License v3, under which the emoji list (emoji-test.txt) and the CLDR emoji names and keywords bundled in the emoji picker are distributed, on the server's information page. Keep 'Unicode License v3' and 'CLDR' as they are.

about.licenses.noto.defaultMessage: Noto Color Emoji font (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
about.licenses.noto.description: Link to the plain-text SIL Open Font License 1.1, under which the Noto Color Emoji font that draws emoji is distributed, on the server's information page. Keep 'Noto Color Emoji' and 'SIL Open Font License 1.1' as they are.

about.rules.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page with the server's rules.

about.source.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that tells where to get the source code of the server's software.

about.source.license.defaultMessage: This server runs free software under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 (AGPL-3.0). Everyone who uses the server may get the source code that it runs.
about.source.license.description: Paragraph in the source code section of the server's information page: the license of the server's software and the right of its users to get the source code.

about.source.view.description: Link to the web page where the source code of the server's software is published, on the server's information page and the landing page. The link leaves the app.

about.source.request.defaultMessage: Request the source code by email
about.source.request.description: Link that writes an email to the address where the server's operators take requests for the source code of the server's software, on the server's information page and the landing page.

about.source.address.description: Term before the email address that takes requests for the source code, in the source code section of the server's information page.

about.title.description: Heading and document title of the server's information page, which everyone may read. {instance} is the name of this server.

about.retention.title.description: Heading of the section of the about page that states the server's maximum of how long local posts are kept.

about.retention.description.defaultMessage: On this server, posts are deleted automatically at most {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after they're published. Members can choose a shorter time but cannot turn this off.
about.retention.description.description: The server's maximum of the automatic deletion of old posts on the about page. {days} is the most days a post is kept.

about.retention.allowed.defaultMessage: Members can keep these posts longer:
about.retention.allowed.description: Before the list of the exceptions that the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page.

about.retention.none.description: On the about page, when the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows no exception.

about.retention.pinned.description: Exception the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page: pinned posts.

about.retention.pinned_newest.defaultMessage: Posts pinned to a profile, {count, plural, one {only the most recently pinned} other {the # most recently pinned}}
about.retention.pinned_newest.description: Exception the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page: the newest pinned posts. {count} is how many.

about.retention.bookmarked.description: Exception the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page.

about.retention.favourited.description: Exception the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page.

about.retention.media.defaultMessage: Posts with images or other media
about.retention.media.description: Exception the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page.

about.retention.polls.description: Exception the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page.

about.retention.visibilities.defaultMessage: Posts with the visibilities the author chooses
about.retention.visibilities.description: Exception the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page: keeping posts by visibility.

about.retention.thresholds.defaultMessage: Posts with many boosts or favourites
about.retention.thresholds.description: Exception the server's maximum of the automatic deletion allows, on the about page: keeping posts by their reactions.
